stem:
From 1690 to 1760, Parliament and the king of England allowed colonists in America to exercise a great deal of control over local and regional matters. Historians have described this practice as “salutary neglect.”

Which of the following happened as a direct result of this policy?

options.label: A
options.text: The colonies developed a strong tradition of self-government.

options.label: B
options.text: Many proprietary colonies were converted to royal colonies.

options.label: C
options.text: The colonies refused to participate in a system of common defense.

options.label: D
options.text: Many colonies sought economic aid from other countries.
